properties.text:
The New York City Central Labor Council-AFL-CIO held a rally at Washington Square Park and a march down Broadway to Foley Square to commemorate International Workers Day. Dozens of unions and organizations participated in the  action, with many carrying signs in support of migrants and opposing ICE and war. 

Several organizations participated in a stationary unified, anti-imperialist contingent to greet the May Day march with drums, chants, flags and signs opposing all U.S. wars and defending resistance to U.S. imperialism. A  nine-foot banner declared: “On May Day Defend Workers of the World – Fight ICE, Fight U.S. Imperialism.” A large foam core board read: “U.S. Workers Fight ICE & Help Defend: Cuba, Palestine, Iran, Venezuela & Lebanon!” Some of the groups that participated  included ArmTheDollz, BronxAnti-War Coalition, Demilitarize Brooklyn Navy Yard, Mass Mutual Aid & Scientific Socialism, Palaver Collective, Pratt SJP, StopYourLiesNYT, Workers World Party, and  People's Organization for Progress. In an address to the anti-imperialist contingent, Workers World Party First Secretary Larry Holmes stated: “May Day is about workers in New York, workers in every part of this country. But it’s also about the workers in Iran, the workers in Palestine and Lebanon, in Gaza and Venezuela and Cuba and every place that U.S. imperialism is targeting with bombs and war and starvation in a desperate effort to hold on to their empire, which is crumbling. So Long Live Palestine! Long Live solidarity! Long Live revolution. Workers of the world unite!"
#smashimperialism #victorytotheresistance #longlivepalestine
